description: Collectible voice effect: A deep, slow, booming voice. Applied to the speech voice (pitch 0.3, speed 0.8).
prompt: A kid-friendly 'Giant' voice preset for the built-in speech voice: A deep, slow, booming voice. Choose a pitch (0–2) and a speed (0.1–10) that sound clearly different from the normal voice but stay easy to understand, plus one emoji icon shown when no voice is available.
